newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mostly steady Friday, capping a week of featureless activity, several dealers said.
Dealers from several locations in the United States which include North Carolina, Minnesota, New York, Kansas and Oklahoma, said trading was subdued.
"Most of the trading has taken place," a Buffalo dealer said. "Everybody is booked," a North Carolina dealer said.
A Minneapolis dealer agreed the market was dull with no feature to make it necessary to buy or sell.
"Demand is just steady," the Minneapolis dealer said. "You still have feeder operaions that need to buy millfeeds.
An Oklahoma dealer noted that demand for millfeeds was better than it was three or three weeks ago.
"But it is a slow moving market," an Oklahoma broker said.
